dmg_failure_diagnosis.most_likely_root_cause: The original DMG failure was caused by the Codex sandbox blocking hdiutil access to macOS DiskManagement; this was not caused by missing signing or notarization credentials.
observed_errors: hdiutil create failed with device not configured
hdiutil verbose mode reported that hdiejectd could not start because the app is sandboxed
hdiutil verbose mode reported inability to use the DiskManagement framework
dmg_failure_diagnosis.unsandboxed_result: The same unsigned app+DMG build succeeded after running outside the sandbox.
dmg_failure_diagnosis.unsigned_dmg_feasibility: The generated Tauri DMG script can produce an unsigned DMG when signing/notarization credentials are absent, provided hdiutil/DiskManagement is available.
dmg_failure_diagnosis.recommended_next_step: Continue using the hdiutil/DiskManagement preflight before DMG creation, then collect signed/notarized package and packaged-runtime evidence once Apple signing inputs are available.

release_blockers: unsigned app is not signed/notarized and has no packaged runtime/profile/cross-device evidence
completion_note: Supporting evidence only. This does not complete desktop runtime evidence; signed/notarized package, packaged runtime/profile evidence, packaged runtime performance, and cross-device continuation remain pending.
